editorial.description_en: Ice you can see the water through, tipped toward green rather than violet.
editorial.description_ja: 割れそうなうすい氷のような、青緑がかった白。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.866, C 0.038, h 208.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 薄 (usu, thin) + 氷 (rai, ice), after the seasonal word 薄氷. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Thin Ice" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 薄氷. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — usu-mizu at ΔE00 5.1, iwa-shimizu at ΔE00 6.1, asa-kawa at ΔE00 7.4. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.038 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
